description: This Java source file defines the class PayPalServices, implementing various services for interacting with PayPal's NVP API within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for setting up express checkouts, retrieving checkout details, executing payments, authorizations, captures, voids, and refunds, as well as handling configuration and request/response processing with PayPal. The class encapsulates integrations with PayPal SDK components, entity queries for address handling, and session management for checkout tokens and shopping cart references.

classes.name: PayPalServices
classes.description: A utility class providing integration methods for communicating with PayPal's NVP API, including setting up checkout, executing payment transactions, retrieving transaction details, and managing configuration profiles within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Initializes the PayPal Express Checkout process by preparing request parameters, sending the request to PayPal, handling response errors, and storing the checkout token and cart reference.

methods.name: payPalCheckoutUpdate
methods.description: Handles the callback from PayPal with updated checkout details, processes shipping and address data, communicates with the database to store address info, and updates the shopping cart accordingly.

methods.name: getExpressCheckout
methods.description: Retrieves detailed checkout information from PayPal, ensures customer details are appropriately linked or created, and updates the shopping cart with shipping and customer info.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Completes the Express Checkout by finalizing payment with PayPal, handling errors such as retries, and updating payment method details.

methods.name: doAuthorization
methods.description: Issues an authorization against a PayPal transaction, returning success or detailed error information.

methods.name: doCapture
methods.description: Captures previously authorized funds on PayPal, with error processing and response interpretation.

methods.name: doVoid
methods.description: Void a previous authorization transaction with PayPal.

methods.name: doRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund transaction with PayPal, with error handling and response details.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodGatewayPayPal
methods.description: Fetches PayPal-specific configuration data for API communication, based on context or product store settings.

methods.name: sendNVPRequest
methods.description: Encapsulates sending an NVP request to PayPal and decoding the response, applying credentials from the profile.

methods.name: getCountryGeoIdFromGeoCode
methods.description: Retrieves a country Geo ID from its code via entity query.

methods.name: parseStateProvinceGeoId
methods.description: Resolves a state or province Geo ID based on PayPal return data, entity lookups, and country context.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Starts the PayPal express checkout process by preparing and sending a request with cart details and configured URLs.

methods.name: payPalCheckoutUpdate
methods.description: Updates shipping and address info after PayPal callback, creating or updating contact mechanisms and addresses.

methods.name: getExpressCheckout
methods.description: Fetches checkout details using the token from PayPal, creates or finds user and party records, and updates the shopping cart.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Finalizes the PayPal order, captures the transaction details, and updates payment info for the order.

methods.name: doAuthorization
methods.description: Requests authorization for a payment transaction, handling response errors.

methods.name: doCapture
methods.description: Completes a capture of authorized funds, with error handling.

methods.name: doVoid
methods.description: Voids a previous PayPal payment authorization.

methods.name: doRefund
methods.description: Issues a refund for a captured payment, handling PayPal response and errors.
